system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: agristack_verify_otp and agristack_register_land_parcel. For your information, my district is dummy_district_9740, my area_hectares is dummy_area_hectares_8030, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_6423, my otp is dummy_otp_7011, my state is dummy_state_2145, my aadhaar_number is 100020009599, my ownership_type is dummy_ownership_type_6424.

function.name: agristack_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT register farmer. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

function.name: agristack_register_land_parcel
function.description: Registers a new land parcel to the farmer's profile. Parcel starts as 'unverified'. Requires session_token. Does NOT verify ownership — use agristack_verify_land_ownership. Fails if parcel already registered or details invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Land parcel ID from state records.
